_doc: Palette v3 colour map for code (2D Artist, 2026-09-29; Bar: 'more in Israel's palette, with blue and white'). Every top-level '#old': '#new' pair re-values a CHROME colour hard-coded in game/scripts/** and game/web/shell.html from the v2 plum/violet family to the v3 navy / blue-and-white family (art/od-sevev/style-guide.md section 2.3). Apply with tools/apply_palette_map.py (dry run by default, --write to apply, --check for CI). The tool also rewrites GDScript float colours Color(r, g, b[, a]) within 1/255 of a mapped hex, keeping alpha. Keys starting with '_' are notes.
